vision: Enable operations teams to receive real-time incident notifications with SLA tracking and automated alerts via integrated communication channels to improve response time and reduce MTTR.
scope: The solution will provide microservice-based real-time incident notifications integrated with PagerDuty and Slack. It includes SLA timers visible in notifications and ensures sub-500ms latency for message delivery.
success_criteria: Notifications reach all relevant ops team members within 500ms latency.
Integration with PagerDuty and Slack tested and validated for real-time messaging.
SLA timer tracking accurately reflects escalation and resolution metrics.

user_stories.title: Receive real-time incident alerts via Slack and PagerDuty with <500ms latency
user_stories.i_want: to receive instant notifications about incidents through Slack and PagerDuty
user_stories.so_that: I can respond immediately to critical issues and minimize downtime

acceptance_criteria.given: an active incident occurs in the monitoring system
acceptance_criteria.then: Slack and PagerDuty notifications are received within 500ms by all assigned team members

user_stories.title: Track SLA timers for incidents in real-time within the notification interface
user_stories.i_want: to see ongoing SLA timers associated with each incident notification
user_stories.so_that: I can monitor escalation timelines and ensure SLA compliance

acceptance_criteria.given: an incident is active and notifications are sent
acceptance_criteria.then: the SLA countdown timer is visible and updates in real-time until resolution

user_stories.title: Automatically sync incident status and SLA progress between services
user_stories.i_want: to ensure incident and SLA data stays synchronized between PagerDuty, Slack, and internal systems
user_stories.so_that: everyone has consistent, up-to-date information on incident progress

acceptance_criteria.given: an incident status changes in PagerDuty
acceptance_criteria.when: the system receives the update webhook
acceptance_criteria.then: the notification and SLA timer data in Slack and internal tools are updated automatically within 500ms
